q.en: A vendor wants to sell a new tile brand that isn't in the app. What should happen?
q.hi: Vendor ek naya tile brand bechna chahta hai jo app mein nahi hai. Kya hona chahiye?

en: The admin adds it to the master catalog
hi: Admin use master catalog mein add karta hai

x.en: Only the admin creates products. Once it is in the master catalog, the vendor can add stock for it.
x.hi: Products sirf admin banata hai. Master catalog mein aane ke baad vendor uska stock add kar sakta hai.

q.en: Which app does the vendor's team use to manage stock, orders and payouts?
q.hi: Vendor ki team stock, orders aur payouts kis app mein manage karti hai?

x.en: The vendor console is the seller's app. The admin panel is for the Oribrix team, and the customer app is for buyers.
x.hi: Vendor console seller ka app hai. Admin panel Oribrix team ke liye hai, aur customer app buyers ke liye.

q.en: A vendor's IFSC is HDFC1000123. What's wrong?
q.hi: Vendor ka IFSC HDFC1000123 hai. Isme kya galat hai?

x.en: An IFSC has 11 characters and the 5th one is always zero. Here it is 1, so the form rejects it.
x.hi: IFSC 11 characters ka hota hai aur 5th character hamesha zero hota hai. Yahan 1 hai, isliye form reject karega.

q.en: Which of these documents is optional?
q.hi: In mein se kaunsa document optional hai?

x.en: GST certificate, business PAN, cancelled cheque and owner Aadhaar are mandatory. Trade licence, ISO 9001 and MSME/Udyam are optional.
x.hi: GST certificate, business PAN, cancelled cheque aur owner Aadhaar mandatory hain. Trade licence, ISO 9001 aur MSME/Udyam optional hain.

q.en: All documents show Approved, but the vendor can't log in. Why?
q.hi: Saare documents Approved dikh rahe hain, phir bhi vendor login nahi kar pa raha. Kyun?

en: The vendor typed a wrong password

x.en: Final approval is a separate step: open the vendor, set Vendor action to Approved and click Update status.
x.hi: Final approval alag step hai: vendor kholo, Vendor action Approved karo aur Update status dabao.

q.en: A vendor asks for a custom category, 'Outdoor sports'. Who decides?
q.hi: Vendor ek custom category 'Outdoor sports' maangta hai. Faisla kaun karta hai?

en: The admin approves or rejects the request
hi: Apne aap add ho jaati hai
Admin request approve ya reject karta hai

x.en: Custom categories are requests. The admin reviews them during KYC and approves or rejects each one.
x.hi: Custom categories request hoti hain. Admin KYC ke time unhe dekhkar approve ya reject karta hai.

q.en: Your CSV upload fails with an error about 'unit'. What do you do?
q.hi: CSV upload 'unit' wale error se fail ho gaya. Aap kya karoge?

en: Ask the vendor to add units
Add the Unit column to the CSV and re-upload
hi: Vendor ko units add karne bolo
CSV mein Unit column add karke dobara upload karo

x.en: Unit is a mandatory field. Fill it for every row and upload the file again.
x.hi: Unit mandatory field hai. Har row mein bharo aur file dobara upload karo.

q.en: Can a product that has an ongoing active order be deleted?
q.hi: Jis product ka active order chal raha hai, kya use delete kar sakte hain?

en: No, deleting is blocked while orders are active
Only the vendor can delete it
hi: Nahi, active orders ke time delete block hota hai
Sirf vendor delete kar sakta hai

x.en: Products with running orders cannot be deleted. To hide a product, switch it to Inactive instead.
x.hi: Running orders wale products delete nahi hote. Product chhupana ho toh use Inactive kar do.

q.en: A vendor moved their warehouse pin to Lucknow. Products vanished from the app. Why?
q.hi: Vendor ne warehouse ka pin Lucknow pe move kiya aur products app se gayab ho gaye. Kyun?

en: The warehouse went back to Pending
hi: Warehouse wapas Pending mein chala gaya

x.en: Editing a warehouse location sends it back to Pending. Once the admin approves it again, the products come back.
x.hi: Warehouse location edit karne se woh wapas Pending ho jaata hai. Admin dobara approve kare toh products wapas aa jaate hain.

q.en: A product is in the catalog but customers can't see it. What is the most likely reason?
q.hi: Product catalog mein hai par customers ko nahi dikh raha. Sabse likely reason kya hai?

en: No seller has stock for it in an approved nearby warehouse
hi: Kisi seller ka approved nearby warehouse mein uska stock nahi hai

x.en: No seller in an approved warehouse means no listing. Customers only see products stocked near them.
x.hi: Approved warehouse mein seller nahi toh listing nahi. Customers ko sirf paas mein stocked products dikhte hain.

q.en: Admin approved Rs 550 for Vendor A. What does Vendor B see for the same product?
q.hi: Admin ne Vendor A ke liye Rs 550 approve kiya. Same product ke liye Vendor B ko kya dikhega?

x.en: An approved price applies only to the vendor and warehouse that asked for it. Everyone else keeps the catalog price.
x.hi: Approved price sirf usi vendor aur warehouse pe lagta hai jisne maanga tha. Baaki sab ke liye catalog price rehta hai.

q.en: Who approves a vendor's price change request?
q.hi: Vendor ki price change request kaun approve karta hai?

x.en: Price requests reach the admin, who accepts or rejects them from the dashboard after checking the reason.
x.hi: Price requests admin ke paas jaati hain, jo reason dekhkar dashboard se accept ya reject karta hai.

q.en: Shiprocket cancelled a pickup. What's the backup?
q.hi: Shiprocket ne pickup cancel kar diya. Backup kya hai?

en: Dispatch with a local / in-house driver
hi: Local / in-house driver se dispatch karo

x.en: Use the local driver tab in the dispatch window. Support must update the customer, because there is no tracking SMS.
x.hi: Dispatch window mein local driver wala tab use karo. Support ko customer ko update karna hoga, kyunki tracking SMS nahi jaata.

q.en: When you click Dispatch via Shiprocket, what does Shiprocket do automatically?
q.hi: Dispatch via Shiprocket dabane pe Shiprocket apne aap kya karta hai?

en: Picks the courier, assigns an AWB, makes the label and schedules pickup
hi: Courier chunta hai, AWB deta hai, label banata hai aur pickup schedule karta hai
Vendor ka warehouse approve karta hai

x.en: Shiprocket picks the best courier, assigns an AWB tracking number, generates the shipping label and schedules the pickup.
x.hi: Shiprocket best courier chunta hai, AWB tracking number deta hai, shipping label banata hai aur pickup schedule karta hai.

en: Oribrix's share, set by the admin per product
hi: Oribrix ka share, admin har product pe set karta hai

x.en: Commission is Oribrix's share of each sale. The admin sets it per product, and it shows up in settlements.
x.hi: Commission har sale mein Oribrix ka share hai. Admin ise har product pe set karta hai, aur yeh settlements mein dikhta hai.

q.en: What is the target date for the customer-facing launch?
q.hi: Customer launch ka target date kya hai?

x.en: Vendor onboarding starts first; the customer launch is targeted for 1 January, after the pending fixes.
x.hi: Pehle vendor onboarding shuru hoga; customer launch ka target 1 January hai, pending fixes ke baad.
